candidate.name: intraday_global_price_range_revisit_240m
candidate.economic_hypothesis: When a larger share of gross one-minute high-low exploration revisits price territory already explored elsewhere in the continuous session, repeated auction acceptance and liquidity support may persist from the next open through the third close.
candidate.formula: (S-U)/S, where S is the sum of all 240 log high-low interval lengths and U is the exact length of their merged session-wide union in log-price space
formula_steps: Require the exact accepted 241-row source grid, preserve but exclude the standalone 09:30 row, and select exactly the 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00.
Require every selected high and low to be finite and strictly positive with exact raw ordering low_i <= high_i. Do not round, clamp, sort within a bar, repair, or apply a price-grid tolerance.
Map every bar to the closed log-price interval [a_i,b_i]=[log(low_i),log(high_i)] and define its nonnegative length r_i=b_i-a_i. Retain zero-width point intervals with length zero.
Require at least 120 bars with r_i>0. Let S=sum_i(r_i) across the fixed 240 support and require S finite and strictly positive.

Sort the 240 intervals only for the union algorithm by ascending a_i and then ascending b_i. Starting from the first interval, merge the next interval whenever its a_i is less than or equal to the current merged upper endpoint; otherwise close the current component and begin another. Touching closed intervals are merged, which does not alter their measured length.

Let U be the finite sum of b-a across the final merged components. Require U strictly positive and U <= S up to the validation-only tolerance 1e-12*max(1,abs(S)); this tolerance may reject or accept floating-point identity noise but may never change an input interval, U, or S.

Compute q=(S-U)/S. Canonicalize q to zero only when q is in [-1e-12,0); reject values below -1e-12 or greater than or equal to 1. Return q without clipping, ranking, smoothing, weighting, winsorization, or another transform.
candidate.timestamp_semantics: Use the order-invariant spatial union of exactly the 240 continuous-session support intervals. The deterministic sort exists only to calculate a set union; no adjacent, lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock pair is formed.
candidate.zero_missing_denominator_semantics: A valid zero-width interval is retained with zero gross length and may touch a merged component, but does not count toward the 120-positive-range minimum. Fewer than 120 positive-range bars, invalid/nonpositive/nonfinite high or low, low-above-high ordering, nonpositive/nonfinite S or U, union-greater-than-gross beyond validation tolerance, or a result outside [0,1) makes the stock-day missing.
mechanism_distinction_before_values: Permuting the 240 intervals leaves Campaign014 unchanged but can change Campaign010 adjacent overlaps and Campaign012 range reversal.
Holding all 240 range magnitudes fixed while moving intervals among price levels can change Campaign014 but leaves Campaign011 entropy unchanged.

Alternating repeated visits to two separated price clusters can produce high global revisit with little adjacent overlap; a one-way chain of locally overlapping intervals can produce a different global union despite high adjacent continuity.
Campaign014 contains no open, close, activity, transaction price, market peer, cumulative reference, or forward return.
